---
title: Data Cleaning
format: pdf
---

```{r}
install.packages("lwgeom")
library(sf)
library(lwgeom)

#Approach A

# 1. Load data

sr_votes <- read_csv("data/sr_precinct_votes.csv")
sr_shp <- st_read("data/shapefiles/sr_precincts.shp")
districts_2025 <- st_read("data/shapefiles/ab604_districts.shp")

# 2. Check column types

sr_shp <- sr_shp |>
  st_transform(3310) |>          
  st_set_precision(1) |>         
  st_make_valid() |>             
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON")

districts_2025 <- districts_2025 |>
  st_transform(3310)              

# 5. Join votes to geometries

sr_spatial <- sr_shp |>
  left_join(sr_votes, by = "precinct_id")

# 6. Interpolate votes to new districts

votes_2025 <- sr_spatial |>
  st_interpolate_aw(districts_2025, extensive = TRUE)

```
